audience: freelancers and small businesses who invoice their clients with SuperFaktura

useCases.title: Find invoices that are still unpaid
useCases.text: The AI lists issued documents with client, totals and payment status, opens single ones, and adds up what clients still owe.

useCases.title: Review the expenses you recorded
useCases.text: The AI lists received documents by status (issued, partially paid, paid, overdue) with amounts, VAT and supplier, and sorts them by expense category.

useCases.title: Check bank moves and cash register balances
useCases.text: The AI reads imported bank moves with amount, variable symbol and matching state, and the balance of each cash register.

useCases.title: Check stock items and their movements
useCases.text: The AI searches warehouse items by name or SKU with price and quantity in stock, and reads the stock log of one item.

useCases.title: Add a client with a contact person
useCases.text: The AI checks the address book first, then adds a new client and a contact person with name and e-mail. Nothing is sent to them.

useCases.title: Record an expense or prepare a draft invoice
useCases.text: The AI records a received expense as unpaid, or creates one draft, quote, order or proforma for you to review. Nothing is sent.
